# Prism test prompts

## Text-to-image
a red cube on a wooden table, soft light, photo
a blue sphere on a white background, studio
a cozy mountain cabin at sunset, pine forest, detailed
a cyberpunk street at night, neon signs, rain
a bowl of fruit on a kitchen counter, natural light

## Negative prompt (default)
blurry, low quality, distorted, watermark, text, extra fingers

## Image-to-image
make it blue
add snow, winter, night lights
convert to watercolor painting
make it look like a photograph

## Inpaint (add)
a glowing blue sphere
a small wooden toy
a red flower

## Inpaint (remove)
empty background, clean surface
empty street, no people

## Inpaint (color)
(no prompt required; pick a target color)
